content: PartyKit is a higher-level abstraction over Cloudflare Durable Objects (each PartyKit room = one Durable Object), adding room-based routing, hibernation-aware WebSocket handling, and lifecycle hooks. It is designed to pair with a separately-hosted frontend (Vercel, Netlify, etc.) via WebSocket — this is exactly the apps/web + apps/party split already committed to in this repo. Raw Durable Objects (via Cloudflare's own 'partyserver' library, published by the PartyKit team post-acquisition) is a lower-level alternative if PartyKit's CLI/conventions are ever outgrown, but is unnecessary extra plumbing for this project's scale.
